answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove bad attestations, and make reputation non-transferable: a verified history acts as a signal that cannot be copied by spawning clones. Like a crystal, trust must grow slowly through consistent work, so a new identity starts with no weight. An attacker flooding the network from one island of fake accounts must fund every stake and risks losing all of it at once, which makes a sybil swarm expensive instead of free.
